assessment: The manuscript provides fundamental insights into the role of acetylation of PALB2, a protein involved in Fanconi anemia and homologous recombination though its association with BRCA1 and BRCA2. The evidence that PALB2 acetylation regulates its nuclear mobility is multi-faceted and convincing and the major strength is the definition of the role of de-acetylation of the ChAM domain of PALB2 to mobilize the protein under genotoxic stress. Individuals with an interest in genome stability will be the audience for this important study.
